Event: `fe698ae88bd624dfc1647dc47b0448e8` · 2026-10-16T01:49:49Z

> Q3: (a), build it in this package (Tier A platform boundary; steward-red-2 reviews it). Recorded in .wash/local/STEWARD3A-Q2-ruling.md 'Q3'.
> 
> The platform must not require what the page denies: Console::open becomes optional in Redoubt::new; with none, console writes are dropped, reads answer end of input, the size is the default 80x24; the Arc<Console> through the hub, the io and the size query becomes an Option, one path; a host test runs a VM with no /dev/cons through its module to exit. beamlet.md's platform table gains the sentence that /dev/cons is optional and what its absence means; agents.md says an agent's output has nowhere to go but /project/out.
> 
> (b) refused: an agent on the UART is a channel to the box's console the page denies it, and the residual would misstate containment. (c) is (a) with a server for nothing.
> 
> Keep the steward's line, as the lease's end audit while audit records are console lines (STEWARD2's residual): `steward: lease NAME of ACCOUNT/{} exited CODE` (`faulted`, `was killed`), with NAME the notice's name (`alice/agent-1`) so the two lines correlate; the console-line table on steward.md gains the row. Good numbers on the rest (the notice 0.34 s after the lease started): quote them in the report.
